in_tamil.meaning: வளர்ந்து விழுந்து (வளர்ந்து) + கோபம் (ஹேம்) = வளர்ந்து கோபம் கோபம் (ஹேமந்ஷு)
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is growing and prospering, possessing wealth

in_marathi.name: Hemanshu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's mind or thought
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemanshu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। This name derives from the Sanskrit words ‘hima’ (snow) and ‘ansu’ (mind or thought). Hemanshu can be interpreted as ‘God’s mind’ or ‘God’s thought’. In Hindu mythology, the god Brahma is considered the creator of the universe through his thoughts.
